name: Brisanet On Nm
summary: Brisanet Serviços de Telecomunicações S.A. is a Brazilian telecommunications company focused on delivering high-speed internet services. Its comprehensive range of offerings includes fiber optic internet, subscription television, music streaming, and both landline and mobile phone services. Founded in 1998, the firm maintains its headquarters in Pereiro, Brazil, and operates as a subsidiary of Brisanet Participações S.A.
